# Themes: every reading

Written by `pnpm themes:readings` from `content/themes/taxonomy.json` and the pinned datasets (Nave's Topical Bible, OpenBible.info's topics). Each of the 808 readings has a home sub-theme, and a second where it scores at least 85% of its home; 142 have a second. 72 readings no dataset cites (mostly the deuterocanonical books, which these Protestant-tradition datasets barely index) were placed by their words, nearest to the readings already in each sub-theme. Status: approved 2026-11-17 (`dc0fee7b54224397`).
